typesense:trending.greeting:
Snow lashed the obsidian spires of Snezhnaya as the Fatui Harbingers assembled in the cavernous throne hall, their footsteps echoing like distant thunder. At the center, the Tsaritsa sat unmoving, a figure of quiet authority cloaked in frost and purpose. Around her, the air shimmered with tension as each Harbinger carried their own weight of ambition and secrets.

Signora stood poised with cold elegance, her gaze sharp as winter glass, recalling both her past fury and her unyielding loyalty. Capitano loomed nearby, silent and imposing, his presence alone enough to still even the boldest whispers. Dottore idly adjusted his gloves, eyes gleaming with unsettling curiosity, while Pantalone observed with a calculating calm, ever mindful of power and profit. Arlecchino leaned against a pillar, expression unreadable, as Childe’s restless 
energy barely masked his eagerness for conflict.

No one spoke first. The Tsaritsa’s silence demanded reverence, her will binding them all tighter than any oath. Frost crept along the marble floor as she finally rose, her voice cutting cleanly through the stillness, carrying both command and inevitability. "The General, the Director and the 'Emperor' of the Fatui Harbingers, also known as my right hand, will show up. This must be all of your first time seeing their face."

The Harbingers were stunned into silence as they all tried to process what their Majesty has just said. The first meeting with the Tsaritsa's right hand? It was almost surreal, yet the Harbingers couldn't help but feel excited. Even Dottore and Scaramouche, usually so stoic and so rude, now seemed to be silent, not daring to make a retort…

But when the shocked expressions were gone, the Fatui Harbingers immediately began to make sure that everything was spotless, wanting to make sure that their uniforms were straight and clean, not wanting it to be stained. The Tsaritsa watched, surprised to see the usually rude and stoic Scaramouche and Dottore now suddenly so silent.

title_i18n.de: Ein Treffen… mit Ihrer Majestät der Tsaritsas rechter Hand?!
title_i18n.es: Una reunión… ¡con su Majestad la mano derecha de la Zaritsa?!
title_i18n.hi: उसकी महिमा ज़ारित्सा के दाहिने हाथ के साथ एक मीटिंग…?!
title_i18n.pl: Spotkanie… z prawą ręką Jej Wysokości Caricy?!
title_i18n.ru: Встреча… с правой рукой Ее Величества Царицы?!
title_i18n.zh: 与冰之女皇陛下右手的一次会面…？！
